data.name: ValuesNotObject
data.value: Send the values as an object from each variable's name to { type, value }.

data.name: ValuesTooLarge
data.value: The remembered values go over 64 KiB.

data.name: NameInvalid
data.value: Each name is a variable name: it starts with a letter, _ or $, has up to 64 characters and is neither a reserved word nor a Prism name.

data.name: NameRepeated
data.value: A name appears twice in the values.

data.name: EntryInvalid
data.value: Each value is an object { type, value }, or { type: "list", items }.

data.name: ListInList
data.value: A list does not hold another list.

data.name: ItemsInvalid
data.value: The list's items are a list of { type, value }.

data.name: TypeInvalid
data.value: The type is number, text, boolean, date, timestamp, sql, object, null or list.

data.name: EntryKeysInvalid
data.value: Each value is an object with type and value.

data.name: NullValueInvalid
data.value: The value of the null type is null.

data.name: TextInvalid
data.value: The text has half of a UTF-16 pair or invalid UTF-8.
